topic.title: Basic Calculator
topic.description: A simple four-operation calculator using functions stored in a dictionary. Demonstrates how to map operators to functions for clean dispatch logic.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Defining functions for each arithmetic operation and using a dictionary to select the right function based on operator input.
learningNotes.challenges: Handling division by zero and invalid operator inputs gracefully.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add a loop for continuous calculation and support for more operations.
